id.description: Optional ID for the carousel region

slides.description: Slides with content and an optional accessible label; image props can also be used in Django

items.description: Content and accessible name for one slide

label.description: Optional accessible name for the slide

children.description: Each child becomes a slide; Django children may be pre-rendered HTML or an array of HTML fragments

role.description: Use group for a carousel nested in another component

showDots.description: Show slide selection buttons when there are multiple slides; hidden buttons appear on focus

statusClassName.description: Additional classes for the slide status element

className.description: Additional classes for the carousel region
